creator: Alexander Terp
description: Alex's chat note, 2026-07-08: "set_debug function, prob others". Global options such as debug, quiet and color can only be set by flags on the command line; a script cannot turn them on for itself. #153's Tier 3 asks for the same thing for quiet (a script-level default).
title: Let scripts set global options at runtime (set_debug, set_quiet, ...)
